title: Project skill registry was fully stale — 13 jnwb/labyrinth skills were invisible to every Claude Code session
notes: RECEIPT (pre-fix): .claude/settings.json registered 15 skills; all 15 pointed at .agents/skills/<name> directories with dir_exists=False (nwb-io, spiking, lfp, tfr, visualization, functional-connectivity, pie-charts-summary, single-unit-*, tfr-*).

RECEIPT (pre-fix): 13 skills existed on disk with valid frontmatter and were registered nowhere (jnwb-core, jnwb-spiking, jnwb-tfr, jnwb-statistics, jnwb-visualization, jnwb-functional-connectivity, jnwb-jrsa, jnwb-population, jnwb-metadata, nwb-analysis-forms, labyrinth-protocol, progress-review-plan, docx-editing).
Root cause: the PRP -> Labyrinth migration deleted the first-generation skill dirs but never updated the registry. Consistent with the 176-path dirty working tree.
RECEIPT (post-fix): registered=13, REGISTERED-BUT-MISSING=0, all 13 resolve to an existing SKILL.md. settings.json parses OK.

Corrects ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md Skill Registry section, which claimed the Omission set loads 'via the table in .agents/AGENTS.md' (it does not — loading is via .claude/settings.json) and omitted jnwb-jrsa and docx-editing.

Relocated the Omission footguns block out of ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (loads in every project) into D:/workspace/omission/CLAUDE.md. Global 20259 -> 18567 chars; project 1452 -> 3408 chars. Always-loaded guarantee preserved within this repo.

Also applied: disabled 3 unused plugins (adobe-for-creativity, cowork-plugin-management, vercel; all lifetime usageCount=0), set permissions.defaultMode=auto at user scope, updated Claude Code 2.1.147 -> 2.1.220.

Install health otherwise clean: native install only, PATH resolves correctly, no npm-global or ~/.claude/local leftovers, all settings files parse, no hooks configured, zero CLI-stamped tool denials in a 10-transcript / 2026-07-02..28 window.
issues: Scan window is thin (numStartups=7, 10 transcripts) — plugin disuse verdicts rest on lifetime counters, not window activity.
context-checkpoint-seal-20260726 carries its 4 edges duplicated 6x (24 entries) — a Redundancy mismatch inflating any edge-count metric. Not repaired this turn.
The .agents/AGENTS.md skill table should be re-checked against the now-correct 13-entry registry; it was the doctrine source the stale global memory pointed at.
plan: On next Adapt pass, reconcile .agents/AGENTS.md skill table with .claude/settings.json as the single loading source of truth.

verification.receipt: probe3.py re-run post-fix: 13/13 registered skills resolve to an existing SKILL.md, 0 missing; claude --version = 2.1.220; both settings.json files parse with expected keys.

links.reasoning: The seal reported a fully healthy toolchain state, but the skill registry was broken across that entire period — no session since the PRP->Labyrinth migration could load a jnwb-* skill.
